summary.scope: Full default Windows native all-target test run after atomic Git/Store publication changes, plus separate actual OS/TLS CLI gates, Python17 and TypeScript mandatory checks. Native host-gated ignored cases, persistent whole-history continuation, unattended App integration, production/remote-source/semantic reasoning and full STATUS/upstream equivalence remain open. Preserve all failures and their exact source scope; do not equate a default run with all live or hosted platform certification.

findings: Explicit automatic bounded captured-head history acquisition inherits the exact verified disk-origin source scope and head epoch. Existing date-priority nonmerge/nonempty-message rows and direct parents are selected automatically. Current App/repository grants and host capture/history/Git-trust/write flags precede host file/Store acquisition. No signing credential, network/model provider or checkout/latest mutation is introduced.

Shared candidate file/source/commit/tree listing/entry allowances are debited before object bodies are retained. Native commit/tree/blob hashes and path/ignore/secret/binary/mode rules remain authoritative. Fresh aggregate source/graph replay and mapped relations precede exact result-byte admission. Duplicate/parallel syntax evidence and false completeness/semantic identity flags remain intact.

One owned immediate WAL/FULL SQL transaction contains every snapshot, graph, FTS symbol/document, publication timestamp, inherited scope, commit artifact registration and source receipt. A second-target receipt failure rolls back the fully prepared first target as well. CAS files can remain unreferenced after failure and provide no authority. Existing snapshot/graph/scope/receipt collisions are refused. Ordinary single-commit Git capture now uses the same atomic SQL boundary.

Ten new actual Git/SQLite/CLI cases cover SHA1/SHA256, epochs8/9, Unicode/CRLF, dirty checkout/index/latest preservation, offline mapping agreement, repeat identity, default/scope/disk-source/caller-transaction denial, aggregate budget exhaustion, exact output limits, late multi-target rollback, corruption, durability/SQL policy/expiry, host-path refusal and zero-history nonpublication. Existing Git/capture/mapping contracts are retained.

Development r1 all-target check passed with one unused import warning. r2 passed9 capture-policy and8 acquisition cases but a new FTS-trigger test setup was invalid (SQLite disallows virtual-table triggers); later targets did not run in that fail-fast command. r3 passed41 selected cases including10 acquisition cases, then Clippy rejected an as_ref/map expression; r4 corrected it to as_deref and all-target Clippy passed. All raw attempts are retained.

Two initial frozen whole-native builds failed with actual LNK1180 disk-space errors before executing native tests; all other gates passed in both attempts and640 inputs remained unchanged. Cache deletion was rejected by automatic approval review and never executed. Ordinary reversible NTFS compression preserved all112 executable,132 debug-file and10542 generated-file hashes. No data was deleted. The final native build reduces only Cargo compiler/linker concurrency from2 to1; all target selection, compiler options and two test threads remain intact. Raw logs and hash reports preserve the exact environment recovery. The final full default run is reported separately without adding overlapping attempt counts.

Persistent whole-history jobs/checkpointed continuation, unattended App integration, public production, remote source ownership/verification, semantic reasoning and universal upstream/whole-STATUS acceptance remain open. Original353 inventory identities,73 unreconciled rows,77 backend unknowns and false full-contract certifications are retained. No release, main merge, live App deployment or public comment is claimed.

Final full default execution covers all262 testable Cargo targets plus the example harness,263 result groups:2389passed/10failed/39ignored. All ten failures are independently classified as OS1314 while creating real Windows symbolic-link fixtures; security assertions are not reached and no test is weakened. Format/all-target Clippy, doctests0, Python17, TS260/3skip/typecheck and two actual OS/TLS CLI gates pass. A manually elevated, source/CLI/test-hash-bound ten-case replay helper is prepared and parsed but not executed; Windows rights are unchanged. Full default and whole-STATUS acceptance remain false.
